items.title: Project Kickoff Meeting & Charter Sign-off
items.description: Conduct kickoff meeting, agree on working rules, internal deadlines, and finalize kickoff meeting minutes.

items.title: Governance & Roles Alignment
items.description: Formalize main/backup role assignments, conflict resolution workflow, and decision-making protocol.

items.title: Preliminary Vision & Problem Statement
items.description: Draft business problem description, target user profiles, and product positioning statement.

items.title: Stakeholder Needs & MoSCoW Scope
items.description: Define stakeholder profiles and categorize features into MoSCoW priority, strictly establishing out-of-scope boundaries.

items.title: Preliminary Architecture & Technology Justification
items.description: Construct preliminary C4 context diagram and evaluate stack suitability (React, Express, PostgreSQL, Vercel/Render).

items.title: Hardware & Operating Environment Specification
items.description: Specify developer machines, browser support targets, and cloud hosting constraints.

items.title: Process Gates & Exit Criteria Definition
items.description: Define phase gate milestones (PA1 to Final) with specific, verifiable exit criteria.

items.title: Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) Authoring
items.description: Structure hierarchical 3-level WBS (phases, deliverables, work packages of 2–8h) with single ownership.

items.title: Effort & Cost Estimation Baseline
items.description: Calculate person-hour estimates and formulate human resource/tooling cost model.

items.title: Project Schedule & Critical Path Mapping
items.description: Build schedule network, identify milestone dependencies, critical path, and initial Gantt chart.

items.title: Project Risk Identification & Mitigation
items.description: Identify at least 5 key risks across technical, people, and organizational categories; calculate RE (P × L) and define contingency plans.

items.title: Version Control & Repository Structure Setup
items.description: Initialize GitHub repository with standard structure (`/src`, `/docs`, `/pa`), README, .gitignore, and branch protection rules.

items.title: Task Board & Tracking Configuration
items.description: Set up GitHub Projects board, configure kanban columns, labels, milestones, and import initial WBS tasks.

items.title: PA1 Document Compilation & Review
items.description: Consolidate individual contributions into PA1 markdown, perform peer review, and finalize submission baseline.

items.title: Domain Modeling & Glossary Definition
items.description: Analyze library circulation domain; define standardized glossary (Book Title, Book Copy, Loan, Reservation, Overdue).

items.title: System Use Case Modeling
items.description: Construct system-level Use Case diagram for Reader, Librarian, and Administrator actors.

items.title: F01 User Authentication & Roles Specification
items.description: Detail functional requirements, login flows, role-based authorization rules (Reader, Librarian, Admin), and use case specs.

items.title: F02 Book Catalog Management Specification
items.description: Specify functional requirements and use cases for adding, editing, and viewing book titles, ISBNs, authors, and categories.

items.title: F03 Book Copy Management Specification
items.description: Specify requirements for tracking physical copies, copy IDs/barcodes, and Available/Borrowed/Reserved state transitions.

items.title: F04 Search & Browse Specification
items.description: Specify search queries (title, author, category, ISBN), multi-attribute filtering, and real-time availability display.

items.title: F05 Borrow & Return Management Specification
items.description: Detail use case flows for loan checkout, due date calculation, return processing, copy state updates, and overdue tracking rules.

items.title: F06 Book Reservation Specification
items.description: Specify reservation queue rules, title reservation when all copies are borrowed, reservation priority, and pickup hold states.

items.title: Non-Functional Requirements & Constraints
items.description: Detail performance, security, data integrity, usability, and browser support requirements.

items.title: Reader/Student Workflow Wireframes
items.description: Create UI wireframes for search/browse, book detail, reservation placement, and personal loan/reservation views.

items.title: Librarian & Admin Management Wireframes
items.description: Create UI wireframes for catalog CRUD, copy inventory, circulation desk (borrow/return/overdue), and user administration.

items.title: Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) Baseline
items.description: Construct RTM linking user needs to functional requirements (F01–F06) and establish test verification methods.

items.title: PA2 Document Review & Verification
items.description: Conduct team walkthrough of SRS, resolve requirement ambiguities, verify against PA1 baseline, and submit PA2.

items.title: C4 Architecture Modeling (Context & Container)
items.description: Create C4 Context and Container diagrams specifying React SPA, Node.js/Express REST API, and PostgreSQL DB.

items.title: Architectural Decision Records (ADRs)
items.description: Author ADRs for JWT authentication, database access patterns, API error handling, and state management strategy.

items.title: Conceptual & Logical Data Modeling (ERD)
items.description: Design Entity-Relationship Diagram covering Users, Roles, BookTitles, BookCopies, Loans, and Reservations.

items.title: Physical Database Schema & DDL Scripts
items.description: Write normalized 3NF PostgreSQL DDL schema with primary/foreign keys, indexes, check constraints, and seed data scripts.

items.title: API Specification for F01 Auth & User Management
items.description: Specify RESTful API endpoints, request/response JSON schemas, and HTTP status codes for auth and users.

items.title: API Specification for F02 Catalog & F03 Copy Management
items.description: Specify REST endpoints for book titles CRUD, copy additions, and inventory queries.

items.title: API Specification for F04 Search & Browse
items.description: Specify endpoints for catalog search with query parameters, filtering, pagination, and copy counts.

items.title: API Specification for F05 Borrow & Return
items.description: Specify endpoints for loan checkout, check-in, loan renewal/due date, and overdue loan listings.

items.title: API Specification for F06 Book Reservation
items.description: Specify endpoints for creating reservations, viewing queue status, cancellation, and pickup fulfillment.

items.title: UI Design System & Component Library
items.description: Design reusable UI components (buttons, modals, tables, badges, form inputs), color scheme, and typography tokens.

items.title: High-Fidelity Mockups for Key Workflows
items.description: Produce high-fidelity mockups for Reader search/reserve and Librarian circulation desk.

items.title: Design Review & Traceability Verification
items.description: Inspect API and DB designs against SRS functional requirements; update RTM and compile PA3 deliverable.

items.title: Master Test Plan Authoring
items.description: Define test strategy, test levels (unit, integration, system), environment configuration, entry/exit criteria, and defect severity levels.

items.title: Test Automation Framework Setup
items.description: Configure backend testing tools (Jest, Supertest) and frontend testing tools (Vitest/React Testing Library) with sample test cases.

items.title: Test Cases for F01 Authentication & Roles
items.description: Author detailed test cases for login validation, password hashing, role-based route guards, and token expiry.

items.title: Test Cases for F02 Catalog & F03 Copy Management
items.description: Author test cases for book title CRUD, ISBN uniqueness, copy status updates (Available/Borrowed/Reserved), and deletions.

items.title: Test Cases for F04 Search & Browse
items.description: Author test cases for keyword search, filtering by category/author, pagination, and availability counter accuracy.

items.title: Test Cases for F05 Borrow & Return
items.description: Author test cases for loan creation, due date setting, return processing, copy status transitions, and overdue loan detection.

items.title: Test Cases for F06 Book Reservation
items.description: Author test cases for reserving unavailable books, reservation queue FIFO, hold status on return, and user cancellation.

items.title: Test Traceability Matrix & Test Data Specification
items.description: Map test cases to SRS requirements (F01–F06) in RTM and document mock test datasets.

items.title: PA4 Document Review & Baseline
items.description: Review test cases for completeness with Developer and BA; finalize and submit PA4.

items.title: Backend Boilerplate & DB Connection Setup
items.description: Initialize Express app, configure PostgreSQL connection pool, migration scripts, and error-handling middleware.

items.title: Frontend Boilerplate & Layout Setup
items.description: Initialize React app, configure router, global state/context for auth, and common layout shell (navbar, sidebar).

items.title: F01 Authentication & Role-Based Access Control
items.description: Implement JWT auth endpoints, password hashing (bcrypt), login UI, and role-protected routes (Reader, Librarian, Admin).

items.title: F02 Book Catalog Management Module
items.description: Implement backend CRUD endpoints and Librarian UI to add, edit, and delete book titles.

items.title: F03 Book Copy Management Module
items.description: Implement backend copy endpoints and UI to register physical copies with barcode IDs and manage Available/Borrowed status.

items.title: F04 Search & Browse Books Module
items.description: Implement catalog search API with multi-attribute filtering and responsive Reader UI with availability tags.

items.title: F05 Borrow & Return Management Module
items.description: Implement circulation API/UI for loan checkout, return check-in, copy status sync, and Librarian overdue list.

items.title: F06 Book Reservation Module
items.description: Implement reservation placement when copies are unavailable, queue ordering, and hold transition on copy return.

items.title: Reader Dashboard & Active Loans View
items.description: Implement Reader dashboard displaying current borrowed books, due dates, overdue notices, and active reservations.

items.title: Automated Unit & Integration Testing
items.description: Implement automated API tests for auth, circulation rules, copy status transitions, and reservation constraints.

items.title: Manual System Testing & Bug Logging
items.description: Execute PA4 test suite against integrated web app; log bugs with steps and severity on GitHub Issues.

items.title: Bug Fixing & Regression Verification
items.description: Fix reported defects in frontend and backend; verify resolved issues and perform regression testing.

items.title: Test Summary Report & QA Sign-off
items.description: Compile test execution metrics, defect resolution stats, and finalize Test Summary Report.

items.title: Cloud DB & Backend Deployment on Render
items.description: Provision PostgreSQL database on Render, run production migrations, deploy Express API, and configure environment variables.

items.title: Frontend Cloud Deployment on Vercel
items.description: Deploy React frontend to Vercel, configure production API base URL, CORS, and custom build scripts.

items.title: Production Smoke Testing & Deployment Documentation
items.description: Perform live smoke testing across all 6 features on production URLs; document deployment instructions in README.

items.title: PA5 Submission & Code Baseline
items.description: Review final repository status, verify deployment health, package artifacts, and submit PA5.

items.title: Demo Scenario Scripting & Seed Data Preparation
items.description: Prepare comprehensive demonstration script and realistic seed data covering all 6 Must-haves and edge cases.

items.title: Demo Rehearsal & Backup Recording
items.description: Conduct full team dry run of live demonstration and record backup video walkthrough of core workflows.

items.title: Presentation Slide Deck Creation
items.description: Author final presentation slides detailing project vision, architecture, demo, metrics, and teamwork reflection.

items.title: Final Contribution Assessment & Project Retrospective
items.description: Compile individual contribution evidence, calculate final percentages, document retrospective lessons, and submit final package.
